tagline: Deterministic script revision cascades and offline safety governance for film production.

scene.heading: INT. CARGO HOLD - NIGHT
scene.original_script:
[Scene 2] INT. CARGO HOLD - NIGHT
John and Sarah search through the storage crates under low emergency lighting.
scene.revised_script:
[Scene 2] INT. CARGO HOLD - NIGHT
John and Sarah search through the storage crates under low emergency lighting.
Heavy atmospheric smoke fills the sealed watertight compartment.
John draws a prop revolver loaded with quarter-load blanks and fires two shots toward the hatch.

safety.reason: MANDATORY STOP: Life-safety regulated activity introduced (Row 1 (Firearms & Explosive Devices), Row 7 (Confined Spaces & Enclosed Tanks)). Cannot roll camera without dedicated certified safety master sign-off.

statutory_citations.title: Mandatory Hazard Assessment Revision
statutory_citations.statute_text: An employer must ensure that the hazard assessment is repeated before work begins on a new work site or when a work process or operation changes.

statutory_citations.citation: Alberta OHS Code Part 28, s.498 & Firearms Act
statutory_citations.title: Firearms & Explosive Devices
statutory_citations.statute_text: Special effects firearms, blank ammunition, and explosive props must be handled exclusively by a certified armorer with direct line-of-sight and verified clear zones.

statutory_citations.citation: Alberta OHS Code Part 5, s.44 (Confined Space Entry & Rescue)
statutory_citations.title: Confined Spaces & Enclosed Tanks
statutory_citations.statute_text: Entry into water tanks, sealed vehicles, or subterranean sets requires pre-entry gas testing, ventilation, and a dedicated rescue plan.
